_comment: Bread category config — TASK-322 spine conformance. Bread is the last bespoke category; this config conforms it to the uniform generate_page path. Source: real_bread_retail_003_v1 (Shufersal, 25 May 2026), 258 BSIP0 → 31 curated → 29 scoreable (2 excluded: no nutrition in BSIP0 scrape). BSIP1: run_bread_conform_001 (31 records, direct Shufersal scrape). BSIP2: run_bread_conform_001 (31 scored). baseline_json set to canonical bari-web copy (19 products with authored Hebrew copy) — copy_stage carries insightLine/rowVerdict/bottomLine for 19/29 overlapping products; 10 new-to-page products get PENDING_COPY. OFF: 0 (nutrition+ingredients from direct scrape only). Scores move vs lechem bespoke scorer — EXPECTED (owner approved 2026-06-18). Flag set: grain/non-dairy (mirrors cereals — RECAL_P0=on, FAT_TECH=on, no shelf-rel, no dairy flags). BARI_SHELF_RELATIVE_V1=off rationale: bread has no single saturated-fat shelf-differentiator; sodium matters but GRAD_SODIUM is not yet evidence-approved; keep disabled per cereals precedent. No BARI_SODIUM_CEREAL (bread is not in the cereal pool). CORRECTION 2026-06-22: baseline_json re-pointed from bread_frontend_v2.json (19 products, stale) to bread_frontend_v3.json — the file the live app actually imports (bread-comparison-page-data.ts + admin/fields.ts); v2 had drifted out of service while the config still targeted it (conformance HARD-3 violation caught by the D4 red-team gate). NOTE 2026-07-01 (TASK-433): crackers split to a standalone category; a membership-correction-only bread_frontend_v4.json (23 survivors, byte-identical scores/grades to v3, brand injected on 2 new + 1 pre-existing, rank renumbered 1..23) was produced at C:\Bari\bari-web\src\data\comparisons\bread_frontend_v4.json via build_bread_v4_membership_correction.py — NOT via this config/pipeline (a full re-score through this config was found to drift one survivor -0.8 pts due to an unrelated router rule added after v3's publication, so re-scoring was explicitly rejected). CUTOVER 2026-07-10 (TASK-561, Product Agent decision, orchestrator-verified): baseline_json re-pointed v3 -> v4, the file the site serves — so the next spine_flip lands in the served page instead of the orphaned v3. CLAIM CORRECTION recorded at cutover: v4 is NO LONGER byte-identical to v3 — measured 15/23 shared barcodes differ incl. one grade flip (2079927 83.0/A -> 78.6/B); v4 was re-scored after creation (served _meta.run_id = task409_rederive_bread_20260626, whose products dir does NOT exist on disk; closest surviving run run_bread_task483_001 matches v4 on 22/23, worst diff 0.2). run_products_dir deliberately NOT re-pointed: no on-disk run reproduces v4 exactly — bread's trace lineage is tracked as NOT FULLY RECOVERABLE under TASK-563. The -0.8 router-rule drift note above still applies to the next full re-score (expected movement to re-verify, per the re-flow policy).
